summary: StudentInformation manages the display and editing of student details associated with placement requests. It handles both individual and group student records, manages anonymous and consent flags, and controls user access to sensitive data such as names, emails, and phone numbers based on user roles, consent status, and contextual business rules.
purpose: To facilitate accurate and privacy-aware rendering, editing, and workflow management of student information in placement requests, supporting business requirements such as consent, anonymity, group/individual handling, and integration with assessments and IT provisioning.

workflows.name: Student Details Display/Edit
steps: Show/hide student fields based on privacy rules
Display or hide group/individual info panels
Handle workflow for editing group size, destination capacity
Save changes with business logic validation

workflows.name: Consent and Anonymity Handling
steps: Determine max length and visibility of name fields
If consent obtained and entered by guest, disable fields for non-admin
Manage anonymous flag based on PR status, group flag, and PAW flag

workflows.name: Student Assignment and Assessment
steps: Setup assigned students for placement requests
Display requirements met status and assessment links/icons

workflows.name: IT Provisioning and Training
steps: Handle training notes and display icons/messages accordingly

business_rules: ConsentObtained must be true to show full student names; otherwise, initials only.
If consent entered by guest, fields are editable only by system admins.
Anonymous flag overrides student name visibility, except for Placement Coordinator in CONF status.
Student names and emails are hidden for non-allowed users or expired consent, unless system admin.
Group PRs hide individual info except when allowed.
Email visibility depends on StudentEmailReleased flag, request status, and business date rules.
IT provisioning actions depend on user roles, flags, and configuration.
validations: Max length and size limits for name fields based on consent
Email must be released and not blank for visibility
Validators on group size and destination capacity fields
Consent and anonymous checkbox logic enforced
calculations: Calculation of confirmed and assigned student counts
Display of requirements met as of specific dates
Block and group assignment based on timetable and rotation status
conditions: Hide students if HideStudents flag is set or receiving mode outside user rights
Show/hide email, phone, student number based on user type and privacy rules
ReadOnly disables editing in various contexts
system_behavior: Controls visibility and editability of fields based on user roles, flags, and context
Handles email, phone, and student number rendering conditionally
Displays assessment and requirements status via icons and links
Updates and saves changes to student info with enforced rules
dependencies: Resources for localized labels and messages
Timetable for block and group assignment
PlacementRequestAssessment and related data for status and display
exceptions: Blank or unreleased email disables stacked/group email display
Expired consent disables viewing names for non-admin users
CFO/canceled PR disables student name display
Shared rotations do not show assigned students
content_gaps: No explicit database schema for StudentInfo and related objects.
Some rules are inferred from code logic—no plain-text business documentation.
No sample data or explicit workflow diagrams.
Assessment and requirement workflows referenced but full details not shown.
